FIELDS.NAME: Upholstery Craft Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Upholstery Craft Co., we specialize in comprehensive upholstery services, offering custom solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations include the reupholstering of furniture, including sofas, chairs, and office seating, using high-quality fabrics and materials that meet industry standards. Our skilled team is trained in specialized upholstery techniques, ensuring a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail in every project.

We prioritize safety and compliance, maintaining documented safety protocols for handling chemicals and materials, and we conduct regular audits of our safety and quality control measures. To protect our operations, we carry comprehensive commercial auto insurance for our mobile services and implement rigorous inventory management practices with appropriate security measures.

Our commitment to customer satisfaction is reflected in our proactive feedback mechanisms, allowing us to continuously improve our services. With a focus on creating beautiful and functional furniture, we strive to uphold a reputation of excellence while adhering to all local regulations and industry standards.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that all staff are formally trained and certified in upholstery techniques, including fabric handling, cleaning, and repair. We utilize only industry-standard equipment and materials, implement documented safety protocols for handling chemicals, adhesives, and machinery, and maintain comprehensive commercial auto insurance for our mobile upholstery services with adequate liability limits.
